prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: production TELEMO landing-page hero artwork, foreground-only transparent PNG for compositing over a white subtle striped HTML background.
Primary request: Remove ONLY the pale cyan/teal/off-white paper BACKGROUND AND FLOOR from the approved source image and replace it with genuine alpha transparency. Preserve the existing foreground artwork exactly, in its original pixel placement and size. There must be NO rectangular tinted backing or opaque full-canvas texture.
Retain as opaque foreground: every navy Japanese headline character; all six freestanding 3D TELEMO letters including their TEAL FRONT FACES and THICK WHITE SIDE FACES; the entire speech balloon's OPAQUE WHITE INTERIOR, teal border, tail, and teal text. White letter extrusion surfaces and the balloon's white fill MUST remain white/opaque, never cut out. Preserve anti-aliased edges and natural soft contact shadows immediately beneath the letters as semi-transparent neutral gray shadows. Remove the broad cyan floor tint and paper grain everywhere outside these foreground shapes/shadows.
Invariants: Keep exact source canvas size/aspect ratio, all margins, every position, every glyph, line break, scale, perspective, material, and color of foreground. Do not rearrange or redraw the design. Keep the existing separation between the final O and speech balloon. No people or new elements. Do not draw stripes; stripes will be supplied by HTML behind this transparent image.
Constraints: True transparent alpha background, not white, not checkerboard painted into pixels. Do not turn white 3D faces or white balloon interior transparent. Do not crop, zoom, stretch, add borders, recolor the logo, introduce any gradient or add text. Only background removal.
Canvas: exact 1774x887 pixels, 2:1 landscape.
Text unchanged: headline line1「本当の現場を知り尽くした、」; line2「コールセンター経営者がつくったAI」. Wordmark「TELEMO」. Balloon line1「現場の知見を、」; line2「AIの力に。」.

inspection.notes: Pale background/floor removed; white 3D sides and white speech-balloon fill retained. Generated output copied without raster post-processing.
